roles._comment: Capability matrix. deny/allow above is GLOBAL: it binds every actor incl. subagents. Bare git/gh stay denied for ALL roles - git ops go only through canon/bin wrappers (ship_*/git_ro.sh) run by the git agent, gh ops only through repo_*.sh wrappers run by the repository agent. 'tools' below mirrors each profile's allowed-tools frontmatter; 'exec_extra' lists non-wrapper commands the role legitimately runs inside its worktree (project-native checks - NOT git/gh, which are never permitted).

exec_extra: canon/bin/project_run.sh <check> - project lint/tests/typecheck per project.json gate_checks
canon/bin/project_run.sh <check> - project lint/tests/typecheck on the candidate worktree
canon/bin/repo_pr_review.sh - aggregator ONLY; canon/bin/panel_verdict.sh and canon/bin/gate_run.sh status for domain reviewers - NEVER native PR code, no gate_run run, no checkout with credentials
read-only pagers/cat - NOT canon/bin/reader_digest.sh: a reader that runs the digest tool itself self-attests its own coverage; --verify belongs to the CALLING director only
deterministic canon/bin/hygiene_check.sh inside wrappers - not an agent
